hypothesis: Because round-limit scoring compares queen length, longest dragon, then total length, a collector that reaches length 12 after round 300 may be worth promoting to flagship behavior before the existing length-16 threshold.

candidate.rule: After round 299, collector length at least 12 also satisfies is_flagship and special_is_flagship; all existing flagship behavior is retained.

decision: Reject before confirmation, fresh all-map validation, diverse opponents, or sandbox. The candidate underperformed and worsened all three official round-limit score components on average. Retain the exact champion.
limitations: This is a tuning screen, not fresh promotion evidence.
The aggregate score-component deltas include elimination games as well as round-limit games.
Local match outcomes are not competition Elo.
